_comment: Helix (vLLM 0.4.0.post1) config for Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B. Architecture numbers match the official config. Changes: model_type=qwen2_moe so transformers 4.40 can parse it (extra fields such as head_dim are kept as attributes); torch_dtype=float16 because T4/V100 have no bf16; max_position_embeddings=4096 so vLLM 0.4.0's max_model_len fits Helix's max_num_batched_tokens=4096 (RoPE values for positions < 4096 are unchanged); shared_expert_intermediate_size=0 (Qwen3-MoE has no shared expert).
